articles.title: Ethena pushes stablecoins into everyday banking with high-yield savings, cards and payments
articles.snippet: Ethena Pay offers a 6% dollar savings rate and 5% card cashback, using Avalanche for settlement.

articles.title: OpenAI’s ‘Trust Us’ TIME cover raises an old warning for AI bulls
articles.snippet: The magazine-cover indicator has a messy record, but TIME’s OpenAI cover checks the classic boxes: a mainstream publication, a widely understood theme and a multiyear run-up in investor enthusiasm.

articles.title: Ethena launches USDe payments app, offers 6% rewards
articles.snippet: The self-custodial app brings USDe into everyday payments, savings and cross-border transfers, with annualized rewards of up to 6%.

articles.title: Bernie Sanders Vows Legislation to 'Stop Flock and AI Mass Surveillance'
articles.snippet: The Vermont senator warned that the surveillance company's 120,000-plus AI cameras are pushing the US toward a "surveillance state," adding a prominent voice to a growing bipartisan backlash.
